summary: The old harness cannot exercise a dictionary-backed streaming round trip on either source version.

assessment.necessity_reason: Dictionary loading and dictionary-aware compressor selection belong to the target's streaming compression surface. A valid nonempty raw dictionary can reach the source path, but the complete old entry and its called parameter helper provide no dictionary to either context. Fuzzer input has no equivalent route.

before.requirement: With a valid dictionary supplied to the contexts, streaming compression must be able to use dictionary content and select a dictionary-aware compressor, with corresponding decompression for the round trip.
before.reason: The before source supports dictionary setup and dictionary-mode selection. The old harness never configures a dictionary before its streaming calls.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The compression context accepts dictionary bytes or a referenced CDict during initialization.
Streaming initialization prepares a loaded local dictionary.
The streaming path passes dictionary state into compression initialization.
A valid raw-content dictionary reaches dictionary-content loading.
The decompression context offers corresponding dictionary setup.

after.requirement: With a valid dictionary supplied to the contexts, streaming compression must be able to use dictionary content and select a dictionary-aware compressor, with corresponding decompression for the round trip.
after.reason: The after source retains the dictionary path. The same old harness still supplies no dictionary to either context.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The compression context accepts dictionary bytes or a referenced CDict during initialization.
The streaming path passes that state into compression initialization.
A valid raw-content dictionary reaches dictionary-content loading.
Streaming decompression obtains its dictionary from the decompression context.
The streaming frame initialization also obtains the context dictionary.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: The complete called helper sets parameters and sequence-producer state without loading a dictionary.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same dictionary-backed operation is supported on both sides. The identical old-harness constraint—no dictionary setup for either context—blocks it on both sides.
